items.title: Submit certified degree certificate and transcript with translations
items.quote: Please send us officially certified copies of your bachelor's degree certificate and your transcript of records, together with certified German or English translations, so that they reach us by 24 August 2027.
items.computation: The letter states a fixed calendar date by which the documents must arrive at the university (not a period to be counted, and not a German authority subject to deemed-delivery rules, since this is a private/applied-sciences university acting as a company-type sender). The date as printed, 24 August 2027, is a Tuesday and is taken as the final day the certified documents and translations must physically reach the International Office; no weekend/holiday shift applies since it already falls on a business day and the letter's wording ('so that they reach us by') fixes the arrival date itself, not a despatch date.

warnings: The letter warns that if the certified documents arrive after 24 August 2027 the reserved place will be given to another applicant, so sending early (certified post with tracking) is advisable rather than relying on the exact deadline date.
